description: Multiple failed login attempts were detected against an administrator account from an unknown external IP address.
An employee received a suspicious email containing a link to an unknown website requesting corporate credentials.
Endpoint security detected malicious software attempting to execute unauthorized processes on a company workstation.
A user attempted to access a restricted administrative resource without the required permissions.
A sensitive company document was accessed by an account that normally does not require access to the file.
Repeated authentication failures were observed for a privileged account within a short period of time.
A suspicious message attempted to trick an employee into clicking a malicious link and providing login information.
A workstation showed signs of malware activity including an unauthorized executable and unusual system processes.
